packages.title: AMUSE Astrophysical Simulation Environment
packages.description: AMUSE is a Python-driven framework that couples specialized community solvers to build multi-physics astrophysical simulations across gravitational dynamics, hydrodynamics, stellar evolution, and other computational astronomy research workflows.

packages.title: ARC Alkali Rydberg Calculator
packages.description: Python toolkit for computing properties of highly excited Rydberg states and interactions in alkali and divalent atoms, including level structure, transition strengths, and electric-field Stark calculations.

packages.title: Astropy Astronomy Core Library
packages.description: Astropy is the core Python library for astronomy, covering units, coordinates, time handling, FITS files, WCS, tables, and cosmology workflows.

packages.title: atomSmltr Laser Cooling and Trapping Simulator
packages.description: atomSmltr is a modular Python toolkit for simulating laser-cooled atoms in custom laser and magnetic field geometries with trajectory integration.

packages.title: BATMAN Exoplanet Transit Light-Curve Modeler
packages.description: BATMAN is a Python package for very fast computation of exoplanet transit light curves, supporting multiple limb-darkening laws for fitting and simulating planetary transit photometry.

packages.title: Biopython
packages.description: Biopython provides Python tools for bioinformatics and computational molecular biology, covering biological sequence parsing, alignments, phylogenetics, and interfaces to common genomics and proteomics data sources.

packages.title: Bloqade Neutral Atom Quantum SDK
packages.description: Bloqade is QuEra's Python SDK and eDSL suite for programming, compiling, and simulating neutral-atom quantum computing workflows on Rydberg-atom hardware and related backends.

packages.title: Cantera Chemical Kinetics and Combustion
packages.description: Cantera is an open-source scientific toolkit for modeling chemical kinetics, thermodynamics, and transport, supporting equilibrium calculations, reactor-network simulations, and one-dimensional flame analyses across multiple programming interfaces.

packages.title: CavMD: Cavity Molecular Dynamics
packages.description: CavMD simulates cavity-coupled molecular dynamics for vibrational strong and ultrastrong coupling, spanning classical and path-integral regimes with workflows for setup, job submission, post-processing, and plotting.

packages.title: CCDProc CCD Image Reduction
packages.description: Astropy-affiliated toolkit for calibrating and reducing optical and infrared CCD observations with overscan, bias, dark, flat, bad-pixel masking, cosmic-ray cleaning, and uncertainty-aware processing.

packages.title: celerite2 Gaussian Process Toolkit
packages.description: celerite2 provides numerically stable, fast one-dimensional Gaussian process regression in Python and C++, optimized for scalable time-series inference with structured kernels and astronomy-focused probabilistic modeling workflows.

packages.title: CESM (Community Earth System Model)
packages.description: CESM is a coupled Earth system modeling framework for simulating climate dynamics across atmosphere, ocean, land, and sea ice components on HPC systems using CIME workflows.

packages.title: Chemicals Thermophysical Data Library
packages.description: Python library with on-demand databases and correlations for pure-component constants, thermophysical properties, safety information, and phase-equilibrium calculations used in chemical engineering workflows.

packages.title: ChemPy Chemical Modeling Toolkit
packages.description: ChemPy is a Python chemistry library focused on reaction kinetics, equilibrium systems, and physical chemistry relations, with practical property models for aqueous and acid solutions.

packages.title: Datamol Molecular Processing Toolkit
packages.description: Datamol is a lightweight RDKit-first toolkit for molecular standardization, structure conversion, fingerprints, conformer generation, visualization, and molecule file I/O with practical defaults for cheminformatics workflows.

packages.title: DeepChem Molecular Machine Learning Toolkit
packages.description: DeepChem provides domain-focused machine learning tools for molecular property prediction, drug discovery, and scientific modeling across chemistry, materials science, quantum chemistry, and biology.

packages.title: DFT-D4 Dispersion Correction
packages.description: Fortran-based implementation of the D4 atomic-charge dependent London dispersion correction for DFT, providing energies, gradients, pairwise decomposition, periodic support, and C and Python interfaces.

packages.title: Enzo-E Exascale Astrophysics Simulator
packages.description: Enzo-E is an exascale-oriented astrophysics and cosmology simulation code built on the Cello AMR framework for massively parallel hydrodynamics and structure-formation studies.

packages.title: ESPResSo Soft-Matter Molecular Dynamics
packages.description: ESPResSo is an extensible molecular dynamics engine for coarse-grained soft-matter systems, supporting advanced electrostatics, hydrodynamics coupling, and flexible Python-driven simulation workflows.

packages.title: exoplanet Bayesian Exoplanet Inference Toolkit
packages.description: exoplanet provides fast, scalable probabilistic models for astronomical time-series, enabling Bayesian transit and radial-velocity inference for exoplanet systems using PyMC-based MCMC workflows.

packages.title: GROMACS Molecular Dynamics
packages.description: GROMACS is a high-performance molecular dynamics toolkit for simulating biomolecules, polymers, and liquids, with strong support for free-energy workflows and trajectory analysis.

packages.title: HOOMD-blue Particle Simulation
packages.description: HOOMD-blue is a Python package for GPU and CPU molecular dynamics and hard-particle Monte Carlo simulations of soft-matter and general particle systems.

packages.title: LAMMPS Molecular Dynamics
packages.description: LAMMPS is a high-performance molecular dynamics package for atomistic and coarse-grained simulations of materials, soft matter, and related many-particle systems.

packages.title: Lightkurve Kepler and TESS Light-Curve Analysis
packages.description: Lightkurve offers user-friendly tools to retrieve, clean, visualize, and analyze Kepler and TESS astronomical flux time series, including light curves and target pixel files for exoplanet and stellar variability studies.

packages.title: MaxwellLink Light-Matter Co-Simulation
packages.description: MaxwellLink is a modular Python framework for self-consistent electromagnetic molecular co-simulation, coupling EM solvers with quantum, force-field, and first-principles molecular dynamics drivers.

packages.title: Meep Electromagnetic FDTD Simulator
packages.description: Meep is an open-source finite-difference time-domain simulator for modeling electromagnetic wave propagation, resonances, and scattering in photonic structures across 1D, 2D, 3D, and cylindrical geometries.

packages.title: MIT General Circulation Model (MITgcm)
packages.description: MITgcm is a flexible geophysical fluid dynamics package for simulating ocean and atmospheric circulation, with coupled ocean sea ice and climate process capabilities.

packages.title: MoleCool Molecular Laser Cooling Simulator
packages.description: MoleCool simulates laser-driven molecular dynamics and spectra, combining optical Bloch and rate-equation solvers, cooling-force mapping, and Monte Carlo trajectories for AMO cooling and trapping experiment design.

packages.title: MOM6 Modular Ocean Model
packages.description: Modular Ocean Model (MOM6) is a finite-volume ocean general circulation model for ocean-only and coupled climate simulations, supporting tracer transport, stratified dynamics, and realistic large-scale ocean process studies.

packages.title: MPAS Model for Prediction Across Scales
packages.description: MPAS-Model is an unstructured-mesh earth system modeling framework for atmosphere, ocean, sea ice, and land ice simulations used in climate, regional climate, and weather research.

packages.title: Nextflow Scientific Workflow Engine
packages.description: Nextflow is a dataflow-driven DSL and runtime for building reproducible, portable scientific pipelines that scale from laptops to HPC schedulers and cloud batch systems.

packages.title: NWChem Computational Chemistry
packages.description: NWChem is a high-performance computational chemistry package for scalable ab initio and molecular simulations, including quantum electronic structure, molecular dynamics, and spectroscopy on HPC systems.

packages.title: Open Babel
packages.description: Open Babel is an open-source chemical toolbox for converting, searching, and analyzing molecular and materials data across many cheminformatics file formats.

packages.title: Open Force Field Toolkit
packages.description: Python toolkit for applying and developing SMIRNOFF molecular mechanics force fields with direct chemical perception, parameter assignment, and cheminformatics workflows for small molecules.

packages.title: OpenMM Molecular Dynamics Toolkit
packages.description: OpenMM is a high-performance molecular dynamics toolkit for biomolecular simulation, offering flexible custom forces and integrators with fast GPU execution through Python and C++ interfaces.

packages.title: OQuPy
packages.description: Open Quantum Systems in Python package focused on non-Markovian process-tensor methods and environment-driven quantum dynamics.

packages.title: Packmol Molecular Configuration Builder
packages.description: Packmol generates initial molecular dynamics coordinates by packing molecules into user-defined regions while satisfying minimum-distance constraints to prevent destabilizing atomic overlaps.

packages.title: Photutils Astronomical Photometry Toolkit
packages.description: Photutils provides robust algorithms for detecting astronomical sources and performing aperture and PSF photometry, with background estimation, segmentation, centroiding, and profile analysis for telescope image data.

packages.title: Psi4 Quantum Chemistry
packages.description: Psi4 is an open source ab initio quantum chemistry package for high accuracy molecular electronic structure calculations, with performant C++ kernels and Python driven user workflows.

packages.title: PyLCP Laser Cooling Physics
packages.description: pylcp is a Python toolkit for modeling laser-cooling systems by constructing internal Hamiltonians, laser and magnetic-field configurations, and solving optical Bloch equations to compute forces and dynamics.

packages.title: Pynbody Astrophysical Simulation Analysis
packages.description: Python framework for analyzing and visualizing N-body and hydrodynamic astrophysical simulation data, including Gadget, Gasoline, Arepo, N-Chilada, and RAMSES AMR outputs.

packages.title: Pysam Genomics I/O
packages.description: Python bindings to HTSlib for fast reading, writing, indexing, and querying SAM BAM CRAM and VCF BCF genomics files used in sequencing alignment and variant analysis workflows.

packages.title: PySCF Quantum Chemistry
packages.description: PySCF is a Python-based electronic structure and quantum chemistry package for ab initio molecular and periodic calculations, including Hartree-Fock, post-HF, and multireference workflows.

packages.title: QuTiP Quantum Toolbox
packages.description: QuTiP is a Python framework for simulating closed and open quantum system dynamics with Hamiltonians, collapse operators, and time-dependent master-equation solvers used in quantum optics and information research.

packages.title: RDKit Cheminformatics Toolkit
packages.description: RDKit is an open-source cheminformatics library for molecular representation, property calculation, fingerprinting, and substructure or similarity search across 2D and 3D chemical workflows.

packages.title: RMG-Py Reaction Mechanism Generator
packages.description: RMG-Py automatically builds detailed chemical kinetic mechanisms and thermochemistry models for combustion, pyrolysis, and atmospheric reaction networks, with Arkane support for pressure-dependent and high-pressure-limit kinetics.

packages.title: scikit-bio Bioinformatics Library
packages.description: Community-driven Python bioinformatics library with reusable data structures and algorithms for sequence processing, phylogenetics, microbiome ecology, diversity metrics, ordination, and omic data analysis.

packages.title: Snakemake Workflow Manager
packages.description: Snakemake is a Python based workflow management system for reproducible and scalable scientific data pipelines that execute on local machines, HPC clusters, grids, and cloud environments.

packages.title: Specutils Astronomical Spectroscopy
packages.description: Specutils provides shared data models and analysis utilities for astronomical spectra, supporting spectral extraction, line measurements, continuum handling, and interoperable spectroscopy workflows in Python astronomy.

packages.title: starry stellar and exoplanet mapper
packages.description: starry provides fast analytic models of stellar and exoplanet surface maps to generate and fit transit, eclipse, and phase light curves.

packages.title: SWIFT Astrophysical Simulation Engine
packages.description: SWIFT is a high-performance astrophysics engine for cosmological particle simulations, combining gravity and smoothed particle hydrodynamics with fine-grained tasking across large HPC systems.

packages.title: Thermo Chemical Engineering Thermodynamics
packages.description: Python package for chemical engineering thermodynamics and phase equilibrium, providing pure component and mixture property models, transport correlations, and rigorous flash calculation workflows.

packages.title: WRF Weather Forecasting Model
packages.description: WRF is an open source mesoscale numerical weather prediction system for atmospheric research and operational forecasting, including regional climate downscaling, severe weather studies, and nested domain simulations.

packages.title: xTB Extended Tight-Binding Quantum Chemistry
packages.description: xTB is a semiempirical extended tight-binding quantum chemistry package for fast molecular energies, structures, frequencies, and conformational analyses across large systems with broad element coverage.

packages.title: yt Volumetric Simulation Analysis
packages.description: yt is a Python library for physically meaningful analysis and visualization of volumetric simulation data across structured and unstructured meshes, particles, and adaptive mesh refinement datasets.
